facts.business: Harig Crankshafts Limited is a real estate developer and civil engineering services company that previously manufactured automotive crankshafts but discontinued manufacturing operations since FY 2010-11.

segments.name: Real estate development and civil engineering services

auditor.name: M/s. M.B. Gupta & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-filing of Income Tax Returns from Assessment Year 2012-13 to 2023-24; Emphasis of Matter on resolution plan approved by NCLT (Note 31) and classification of assets held for sale (Note 13).

key_risks: Non-filing of Income Tax Returns for multiple assessment years (2012-13 to 2023-24) leading to uncertain tax liabilities
Discontinuation of manufacturing business since FY 2010-11
Dependence on successful implementation of Resolution Plan under IBC
Sale of major undertaking (land, building, plant & machinery) approved by shareholders
